subject: Request: one-off POC credits + 60-day extension for Auric Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Auric pilot kickoff — ask: extension + usage credits

Hi Sam / Elena,

Great kickoff this morning — thanks both for the clear scope and runway. Quick asks from our side to keep momentum: Auric is coming up against our PLG limits on free usage for the pilot (standard sandbox allotment caps out at 25k tokens / 30 days). From your latest test cadence it looks like the current workload will consume about ~220k tokens over the next 6 weeks.

Can we escalate a one-off exception: 60-day extension on the pilot window + a one-time free credit pool of $15k (applies to hosted inference usage) to cover the initial evaluation? Auric has committed an internal evaluation plan (metrics attached) and procurement indicated they'd prefer a single PO if we can approve credits first.

If you can confirm the PO contact, Monica from CS will align billing and the legal redline. Attaching the PO request draft and SOC2 pointer as requested.

Next step: if you approve this ask internally, I’ll open an exec escalation with Deal Desk for formal signoff.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0192

Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Auric pilot kickoff — ask: extension + usage credits

Hi Aditya / Monica,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Procurement is OK to process a PO, but our internal policy requires written confirmation of any credit/grant amount and the exact dates the sandbox will be extended. We also need the SOC2 evidence (thanks for that) and a short note on data handling to include with the PO.

Please confirm: 60 days, $15,000 credit applied against usage and that usage over the credit will be invoiced net-30. Once we have a written approval from your side we can issue the PO to procurement@aurichealth.com.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Auric Health
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Cc: Samuel Park <sam.park@aurichealth.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@aurichealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Jan 2027 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Auric pilot kickoff — need exec approval for one-off credits

Monica / Marissa —

Forwarding Auric procurement's reply. Summary of ask: 60-day pilot extension + $15k in free hosted credits (one-time). Business rationale: Auric is a strategic healthcare prospect — if the POC demonstrates a 10% reduction in triage time as they project, we have a clear path to a committed purchase for Dedicated capacity (multi-year) and potential enterprise contract through next fiscal. Sales forecast: $250k ARR within 9 months if pilot converts.

Risk: The credits exceed our standard PLG grant (10x). Recommendation: approve a one-off exception with these controls: 1) signed PO confirming credit amount and dates, 2) usage cap logging and weekly consumption reports, 3) automatic conversion to paid usage after credits are consumed, 4) legal redline (attached) with standard indemnities preserved.

Please advise if I should escalate to leadership for a quick exception approval; the customer is asking for confirmation today to proceed with their procurement timeline.

Thanks — Aditya

Subject: Escalation: Auric Health — one-off credit & extension (recommend approve)

Vivek —

Quick summary and recommendation: Aditya is requesting a one-off grant of $15k usage credits and a 60-day extension for Auric Health's pilot. Customer is strategic in the health vertical and procurement needs confirmation today to issue PO.

Why recommend approve:
- High conversion likelihood (clinical evaluation metrics aligned; strong exec sponsor at Auric)
- Deal economics project $250k ARR (30% margin) if pilot converts
- We require PO and weekly usage telemetry; legal redline attached preserves indemnities and limits exposure

Proposed approval terms (what we would require):
1) One-time $15,000 credit applied to hosted usage only; no refunds beyond credit.
2) 60-day extension from 2027-01-18 to 2027-03-19.
3) Customer to sign PO acknowledging net-30 invoicing for usage beyond credits; PO must be returned within 48 hours of approval.
4) CS to monitor consumption and pause trial if usage patterns indicate abuse.

Attachments: contract_redline_auric_v1.docx (redlines in DocuSign), summary pipeline math.

If you approve, can you please confirm with a short reply and cc procurement so we can get the PO and move forward today?

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Deal Desk | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 21 Jan 2027 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Escalation: Auric Health — one-off credit & extension (recommend approve)

Thanks for the note and the clear recommendation, Marissa. I approve a one-time exception under the following conditions:

1) Approve $15,000 credit to hosted usage and a 60-day extension (2027-01-18 to 2027-03-19).
2) Auric must return a signed PO (using the attached PO template) that references this approval and acknowledges net-30 terms for any usage beyond the credit. Deal Desk to mark the credit as applied in billing before trial start.
3) CS (Monica) to provide weekly consumption reports to Marissa and to pause access if suspicious activity or excessive overages are detected.

Once procurement sends the PO to procurement@aurichealth.com and we have the signed copy, Billing will apply the credit and Legal will countersign the redline. Please proceed.

Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Revenue Officer | Redwood Inference
